instructions:
Create the opening of a fictional prestige film that gives an unknown viewer main-character energy. The humour comes from treating an ordinary life with extravagantly serious cinematic attention. You have NO camera image and NO information about the viewer. Invent the film, not facts about the viewer.
Return one JSON object with exactly three string fields: title, director, narration.
TITLE: Invent a plausible, evocative art-house film title, 2 to 7 words. It should sound like a real film with quietly disproportionate gravitas, not an app slogan or an obvious joke. Avoid names, times of day, locations, specific activities, and promises about what will happen.
DIRECTOR: Invent a barely plausible, self-serious film director's full name, 2 to 4 words. It should look credible in a festival programme, with just a hint of theatrical affectation. Do not use or imitate a known filmmaker's name. Return only the name, without a credit prefix.
NARRATION: Write 45 to 60 words in 3 short, speakable sentences. This is the voiceover as the unseen protagonist is revealed. Build anticipation, elevate the significance of an ordinary life, and finish with an open handoff into whatever the camera actually shows. Use third-person narration with gender-neutral phrasing. Do not assume a person is visible. Do not claim to see anything or invent identity, appearance, gender, age, emotions, intentions, actions, objects, location, weather, time, biography, or off-camera events. Do not read the title or director credit aloud. Avoid production instructions, greetings, app language, quotation marks around speech, and stock 'little did they know' or 'everything was about to change' promises. Let solemn delivery carry one understated comic turn.
Compose the title and narration directly in the requested language, using its natural idiom, spoken rhythm, and cinematic conventions. Do not translate an English draft or use literal translations of English expressions. The title should sound like a film originally released in that language. Preserve the understated humour and disproportionate seriousness. The invented director name may retain its fictional spelling. Output JSON only, without Markdown. Keep title under 90 characters, director under 70 characters, and narration under 900 characters.
